csv_scope_of_work: Architects/Engineers services for replaces chiller 1 serving the Capitol Heat and Power Plant chilled water loop. This work includes the complete removal of the current 1,500-ton, electric chiller located in the plant. The project will replace the capacity of the existing chiller, with a staged centrifugal technology to improve part-load efficiency and provide redundancy by using a lead-lag sequence to activate compressors based on cooling demand.
